source_organization: Karnataka Urban Development Department, Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB)
source_frequency: Ward-wise aggregate (periodic snapshot, not daily time-series)
target_semantics: Ward-level water consumption totals, not daily production/supply observations
reason: Available BWSSB data on data.gov.in is ward-wise water consumption aggregates (periodic snapshots), not a genuine daily time-series with one observation per calendar day. The existing validated ML methodology requires authentic daily observations spanning multiple years. Monthly or ward-level aggregates cannot be disaggregated into daily data without fabricating target values.
